Name: Satrina
Description: Satrina was the lover of Kartag, the giant who was commanded by the Norns to guard the Twilight Well. Apparently their relationship lacked a bit of communication, because Satrina was unaware of her lover's special duty to the Norns. When she could not prevent Thor and his friends from advancing on the well, she led them directly to Kartag, hoping that he would finish them off.
